question: Should OpenClaw sponsor RFC #27’s experimental core Claw lifecycle, including this persisted managed-workspace-file stage, for the ordered implementation stack?
rationale: The patch adds a new core CLI lifecycle, persistent provenance, and package-sourced bootstrap content; code review cannot determine whether that product direction should be accepted into core.

options.title: Pause pending sponsorship
options.body: Keep the stack open but do not merge or dispatch further repair work until an authorized maintainer explicitly sponsors the RFC direction.

options.title: Sponsor and continue stack review
options.body: Accept the experimental core direction, require final-head redacted CLI proof, and review the predecessor-to-successor stack in landing order.

options.title: Decline the core direction
options.body: Close the implementation stack and redirect any acceptable external packaging concept to an extension path.

recommendation.title: Pause pending sponsorship
recommendation.body: Keep the stack open but do not merge or dispatch further repair work until an authorized maintainer explicitly sponsors the RFC direction.
